ns2:section.sectionText: SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS More detailed information about this course is available at http://djs.web.illinois.edu/teach/soc100onl/. The Winter Term is very compressed: Students are expected to do four months of work in just one month. You should only take this course if you can devote four times as much time to this class every day as you would spend on an average day in a sixteen-week semester course. There are holidays during the Winter Term (Christmas Day and New Year's Day), but otherwise expect to spend some time online every day of Winter Term, and to be working every day (reading, thinking, etc.) offline as well.
